scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:portfolio && npm run typecheck:worker
scripts.build:database: npm --prefix packages/database run generate && npm --prefix packages/database run build
scripts.ci:packages: npm run build:database && npm run build:queues && npm run build:templates && npm run build:web3
scripts.ci:portfolio: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:portfolio
scripts._comment:ci: `npm run ci` deve ser identico ao .github/workflows/ci.yml. Se divergirem, o script perde a razao de existir. ci:worker ficou de fora de propósito: `build:worker` emite dist/ que a imagem nunca usa (o Dockerfile roda `npx tsx index.ts`), e `typecheck` ja cobre o worker via tsc --noEmit.
scripts.ci:phase1: npm run ci:packages && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.ci: npm run ci:phase1 && npm run test:unit && npm run build:portfolio
scripts.test:phase3: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
